params.description: The SID of the [Sim resource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iot/wireless/api/sim-resource)  to read the usage from.

params.name: End
params.description: Only include usage that occurred on or before this date, specified in [ISO 8601](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html). The default is the current time.

params.name: Start
params.description: Only include usage that has occurred on or after this date, specified in [ISO 8601](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html). The default is one month before the `end` parameter value.

params.name: Granularity
params.description: How to summarize the usage by time. Can be: `daily`, `hourly`, or `all`. The default is `all`. A value of `all` returns one Usage Record that describes the usage for the entire period.
